task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the blue cream cheese package.
Reach the open gripper toward the blue cream cheese package on the table.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper down toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Lift the blue cream cheese block up off the table, moving it toward the bowl.
Carry the cream cheese over the table toward the bowl.
Lower the blue cream cheese block down into the bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and retract the empty gripper upward.
Retract the open gripper upward and away from the bowl containing the cream cheese.
